testo:
■ Super Guardman (When one of your other creatures would battle, you may tap this creature to have it battle instead.)
■ This creature can't attack.
■ Whenever your opponent puts a creature from a zone other than their hand, you may have this creature battle that creature.

■ このクリーチャーは攻撃できない。
■ 相手のクリーチャーが手札以外から出た時、このクリーチャーとそのクリーチャーをバトルさせてもよい。
